title: Security Trading Policy

tiers.name: Designated Personnel
tiers.description: Any director of the Bega Cheese Group, the CEO, the Senior Executive Team and their direct reports, the Company Secretary, the Specified Finance Team, and the Executive Assistant, and any other persons designated by the Board or the Chairperson from time to time.

tiers.name: Chairperson
tiers.description: The Chairperson of the Board; distinguished only for the identity of the Relevant Officer who considers their clearance applications (the Chair of the Audit & Risk Committee, instead of the Chairperson).

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: Directors of the Bega Cheese Group; distinguished only for a mandatory post-trade notification to the Company Secretary within two days of any dealing.

definitions.hedging_definition: transactions in associated products which limit their economic risk

windows.start_anchor: the day following the release of Bega Cheese's half year results to the ASX
the day following the release of Bega Cheese's year end results to the ASX
the day following the Annual General Meeting of Bega Cheese

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Board or the Chairperson may prohibit trading by any Designated Person during a Trading Window (clause 4.2), and may notify a Designated Person that they are subject to a blacklist on another entity's securities for a specified period (clause 6.2). The Policy does not state whether these prohibitions are confidential, though a refusal of clearance to trade must be kept confidential (clause 5.7).

rules.detail: Securities is defined to include 'any derivatives including but not limited to options' in respect of Bega Cheese shares and related instruments, with no venue limitation, so an OTC put/call is a Security. Dealing (applying for, acquiring or disposing of securities, or agreeing to do so) therefore requires clearance under clause 5.0 and may only occur within a Trading Window.
rules.evidence: any derivatives including but not limited to options in respect of any of (a) to (e) above.

rules.detail: Absolute ban on entering transactions in associated products which limit the economic risk of unvested entitlements under equity-based remuneration schemes; no clearance route.
rules.evidence: A Designated Person who participates in unvested entitlements under any equity-based remuneration schemes is prohibited from entering into transactions in associated products which limit their economic risk.

rules.detail: Clause 11.1 only names unvested entitlements; the Policy has no concept of a vested holding lock. A hedge over vested securities is not named but is a Dealing (a derivative Security) requiring clearance under clause 5.0 and restricted to a Trading Window.
rules.evidence: Dealing means applying for, acquiring or disposing of securities, or entering into an agreement to do any of those things.

rules.detail: Monetisation structures such as a prepaid forward are not named; they are caught as an agreement to dispose of securities and require clearance under clause 5.0 within a Trading Window.
rules.evidence: Dealing means applying for, acquiring or disposing of securities, or entering into an agreement to do any of those things.

rules.detail: Short selling is not mentioned anywhere in the Policy.
Securities lending is not mentioned anywhere in the Policy.
CFDs are not named. A CFD referencing Bega Cheese shares is a derivative 'in respect of' Securities and so a Dealing requiring clearance under clause 5.0 within a Trading Window.
rules.evidence: any derivatives including but not limited to options in respect of any of (a) to (e) above.

rules.detail: Blanket ban on margin lending arrangements when purchasing or selling Bega Cheese securities, with no approval route or security-state carve-out.
rules.evidence: A Designated Person is prohibited from entering into margin lending and other secured financing arrangements when purchasing or selling Bega Cheese securities.

rules.detail: Granting a charge, lien or pledge over already-held Bega Cheese securities, other than in connection with purchasing or selling them, is not named and 'Dealing' does not expressly extend to encumbrance.

Bans margin lending and 'other secured financing arrangements', extending the prohibition beyond margin loans, but only 'when purchasing or selling Bega Cheese securities'. A loan secured on already-vested shares that involves no contemporaneous purchase or sale is not squarely within the literal wording, which is a key point to clear with the Relevant Officer.
rules.evidence: A Designated Person is prohibited from entering into margin lending and other secured financing arrangements when purchasing or selling Bega Cheese securities.

rules.detail: The Policy contains no minimum holding period or short-term/speculative dealing restriction; dealing is instead controlled solely by the Trading Windows and clearance procedure.

clearance.approver: the Chairperson (as Relevant Officer), via written clearance signed by the Company Secretary on the Chairperson's behalf
clearance.post_trade_deadline: when the approved trading has been completed
clearance.evidence: No dealing may be undertaken before the Designated Person receives written clearance from the Company Secretary, signed for and on behalf of the Relevant Officer... Any clearance to trade can be given or refused by Bega Cheese at its discretion, without giving reasons.

clearance.approver: the Chair of the Audit & Risk Committee, via written clearance signed by the Company Secretary on their behalf
clearance.post_trade_deadline: when the approved trading has been completed
clearance.evidence: in the case that the Chairperson is applying to deal in securities, the Chair of the Audit & Risk Committee

clearance.approver: the Chairperson (as Relevant Officer), via written clearance signed by the Company Secretary on the Chairperson's behalf
clearance.post_trade_deadline: as soon as practicable, and in any case no more than two days, after dealing
clearance.evidence: As soon as practicable (and in any case no more than two days) after a director deals in Bega Cheese securities at any time, the director must notify the Company Secretary of: a. the date of the transaction; b. the number of Bega Cheese securities involved; c. whether it was a sale, purchase, or subscription; d. the consideration paid.

exceptions.evidence: whether the Designated Person is suffering severe financial hardship
whether the Designated Person is bound by a court order, enforceable undertaking or other legal or regulatory requirement to transfer or sell the securities of Bega Cheese

transfers of securities already held by a Designated Person into a superannuation fund or other saving scheme in which the Designated Person is a beneficiary in respect of which prior written approval has been granted in accordance with clause 5.0 except during any Corporate Activity

where a Designated Person is a trustee, trading in the securities of Bega Cheese by that trust provided the Designated Person is not a beneficiary of the trust and any decision to trade during a Prohibited Period is taken by the other trustees or by the investment managers independently of the Designated Person
undertakings to accept, or the acceptance of, a takeover offer
a disposal of Bega Cheese's securities arising from the acceptance of a court-approved scheme of arrangement or equal access buy-back
an acquisition of Bega Cheese's securities under a Bega Cheese dividend reinvestment plan or an employee incentive plan
a disposal of rights or acquisition of securities under a pro rata issue by Bega Cheese
any other transactions identified by the Board for this purpose.

external_documents: Agreements between Bega Cheese and a Designated Person or a Securityholder restricting trading of securities
exemption_authority: The Relevant Officer (the Chairperson, or the Chair of the Audit & Risk Committee where the Chairperson is the applicant) may grant written clearance to trade during a Prohibited Period in exceptional circumstances (severe financial hardship, a court order or enforceable undertaking, or other exceptional circumstances where the dealing is the only reasonable course of action), provided the applicant is not in possession of inside information; clearance can be refused at absolute discretion without reasons, and any refusal is final, binding and confidential.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The trading restrictions set out in this policy are additional to any provisions governing or restricting the trading of securities set out in any agreement between Bega Cheese and a Designated Person or a Securityholder or any provisions in Bega Cheese's employee share plans... the most restrictive provisions will prevail.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even where this Policy permits or is silent on a collar or loan structure, the executive's individual equity plan rules or other agreements may impose stricter hedging or encumbrance restrictions that override this Policy and must be separately checked.

bespoke_clauses.clause: A Designated Person is prohibited from entering into margin lending and other secured financing arrangements when purchasing or selling Bega Cheese securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The ban is framed around financing 'when purchasing or selling'; a loan secured on already-vested shares with no contemporaneous purchase or sale of Bega Cheese securities arguably falls outside the literal wording, but this gap should be confirmed with the Relevant Officer rather than assumed.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Any clearance to trade can be given or refused by Bega Cheese at its discretion, without giving reasons... the refusal must be kept confidential and not disclosed to anyone.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The bank cannot rely on any right to clearance; approval is wholly discretionary, reasons for refusal will not be given, and a granted clearance can be withdrawn before execution if circumstances change.

bespoke_clauses.clause: A clearance to trade can be withdrawn if new information comes to light or there is a change in circumstances.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A cleared collar could lose its clearance before execution within the 14-day window, so the collar should be documented and executed promptly after approval.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Bega Cheese may blacklist certain securities in relation to particular Designated Personnel... that Designated Person must not deal in the Blacklisted Securities for the time period specified in the notice.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: If the collar references, or the executive also holds, securities of another entity connected to Bega Cheese's dealings, a blacklist notice could independently block that leg of the structure.

bespoke_clauses.clause: dealing by Designated Personnel in Bega Cheese's securities may take place only during the following periods... (collectively the Trading Windows).
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Absent an exceptional-circumstances clearance, the collar's entry, unwind or roll may only occur within the three 30-day Trading Windows each year (post half-year results, post full-year results, post AGM).

summary: A funded collar over vested and unrestricted Bega Cheese shares is achievable in principle: the derivative legs are a 'Dealing' requiring prior written clearance from the Relevant Officer (the Chairperson, or the Chair of the Audit & Risk Committee for the Chairperson), executable only within one of the three annual 30-day Trading Windows (post half-year results, post full-year results, post AGM) or under an exceptional-circumstances clearance, and completed within 14 days of approval. Hedging of unvested entitlements is absolutely prohibited with no clearance route. The loan leg is more doubtful: clause 11.2 bans margin lending and 'other secured financing arrangements... when purchasing or selling' Bega Cheese securities, and while a loan secured on already-vested shares not involving a contemporaneous purchase or sale may sit outside the literal wording, this should be confirmed with the Relevant Officer rather than assumed, and any conflicting restriction in the executive's own equity plan or employment agreement will override this Policy under its 'most restrictive prevails' rule. Clearance is entirely discretionary, unreasoned, confidential if refused, and can be withdrawn before execution, so the collar's timing carries real approval risk. No minimum shareholding requirement or standing financing-disclosure duty is stated, but directors must notify the Company Secretary of any dealing within two days.
